essence: Recitation is offered while uttering the formula beginning with secret, most-secret, and protectorship.
After invoking all powers in that water, one should perform worship.
The tradition knows spikenard mixed with kapi as Śakti’s eight-fragrances.
The eight-fragrances of Viṣṇu are remembered in tradition.
The Śaiva eight-fragrances are remembered as being mixed with kuṣṭha.
